title: Abandoned Shopping Cart
description: A red and grey shopping cart stands alone in an empty, dimly lit institutional hallway. The cart contains an unfolded large canvas or print, scattered paint tubes, and a long receipt dangling from its side, with more debris and paint splatters on the concrete floor.
prompt: A realistic painting of a red shopping cart abandoned in the middle of a stark, empty institutional hallway with purple fluorescent lighting. The cart holds an unfolded large white canvas with text, several paint tubes, and a long white receipt hanging from the side. Paint splatters and another receipt lie on the grey concrete floor. Cool blue-grey tones, melancholic and eerie atmosphere, cinematic composition.
